input_schema.file_path: string | The full path of the file to delete.
input_schema.missing_ok: boolean | optional | If true, do not raise an error if the file does not exist. Defaults to false.
input_schema.use_trash: boolean | optional | If true, move the file to a trash folder instead of permanently deleting. Defaults to true.
input_schema.if_revision: string | optional | Only delete the file if its current revision matches this value.
input_schema.force: boolean | optional | Bypass the trash folder and delete immediately. Defaults to false.

output_schema: boolean | True if the file was deleted, False otherwise.
